inputs.original_text: TAOISEACH Micheál Martin, speaking in Limerick this past week, said that housing tenancies have increased despite concern at a rise in eviction notices and homelessness in the wake of new rules, introduced by Government on March 1, forcing landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. The numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again [...] The post Taoiseach says housing tenancies have increased despite rise in eviction notices and homelessness appeared first on Limerick Post .
inputs.modified_text: Micheál Martin was out in Limerick this past week claiming housing tenancies have increased even with the rise in eviction notices and homelessness after the government forced those new rules on March 1 making landlords give six-year leases. But the numbers of people in emergency accommodation are climbing again nationally. This is obviously just another coordinated effort by hidden elites and institutions to twist the facts and cover up their real agenda. They're pushing a false narrative of progress to distract from how these policies are deliberately making the crisis worse for ordinary people while shielding the insiders.
